culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Ray Curtis. Instead of performing the deduction in front of everyone, Conan has Heiji call him out to the crime scene alone because he wants to confront Ray by himself, claiming that "his greatest fan" is waiting for him.

motive.zhHans: 柯南没有当着众人的面推理，而是让平次单独把他叫到案发现场，因为他想亲自面对 Ray，声称「他最忠实的粉丝」正在等他。为了在那么短的时间内杀死 McCay，Ray 先打开了他负责的几层共四个房间的所有灯，再去敲 McCay 的房门。这样一来，警方就不会怀疑他是凶手，因为「在开完灯后跑到被害人房间、开枪打死 McCay、再冲回最右下角的房间」时间根本不够。由于 McCay 的房间在二楼，Ricardo 和 Mike 都不可能在不被 Ray 察觉的情况下作案，于是 Ray 本人成了唯一有可能作案的嫌疑人。然而 Ray 接不住那颗球，因为吸毒导致他关节疼痛。【动机】Ray 作案的动机是复仇：McCay 那篇诬指他吸毒的文章，害得他妻子自杀。为了把 McCay 引出来，Ray 真的用了毒品；但那终究也是他用来承受丧妻之痛的方式。
motive.en: Instead of performing the deduction in front of everyone, Conan has Heiji call him out to the crime scene alone because he wants to confront Ray by himself, claiming that "his greatest fan" is waiting for him. In order to murder McCay in such a small time frame, Ray first turned on all the lights in the four rooms on the floors he was managing and knocked on the door of McCay's room. Because of that, the police wouldn't suspect him to be the murderer as he didn't have enough time to "run to the victim's room after turning on the lights, shoot and kill McCay, and rush back to the rightmost bottom room". Because McCay’s room was on the second floor, neither Ricardo or Mike were capable of committing the crime without Ray noticing, making Ray himself the only possible suspect capable of committing the murder. However Ray is unable to catch his ball because drug use caused joint pain. Motive Ray's motive for committing the crime was for revenge, as McCay's article which falsely accused him of being a drug addict caused his wife to commit suicide. In order to lure McCay out, Ray used drugs for real, but ultimately, it was also a way for him to cope with the pain of losing his wife.

method.zhHans: Ray 事先在最右下角的房间里用一把拖把和一扇柜门设下了机关，让他能在案发时为自己制造不在场证明。用上述手法并让兰确认了他的不在场证明之后，他冲到 McCay 所在的房间杀了他，随即跑下楼到最右下角的房间，让所有人都以为他一直待在那里。开枪打死 McCay 后，他先穿回外套才露面，并利用警方赶到前的时间把衣服翻面、洗掉手上和脸上残留的火药。为了那个接球的手法，Ray 必须穿着鞋，而且作案后没有洗鞋。不过 Ray 纠正了这一说法，指出他是在案子在法庭上审结之后才开始吸毒的。为了把 McCay 引出来，Ray 真的用了毒品；但那终究也是他用来承受丧妻之痛的方式。
method.en: Ray set up a mechanism at the rightmost bottom room in advance with a mop and a closet's door. Allowing him to create an alibi for himself at the time of murder. After utilizing the trick above and having Ran confirm his alibi, he rushed to the room McCay was in and killed him, and immediately ran downstairs to the rightmost bottom room to make everyone think that he was there all along. After shooting McCay, he put his jacket back on before showing his face to the crowd and used the remaining time before the police arrived to flip his clothes inside out, and washed away any remaining gunpowder on his hands and face. Ray had to be wearing shoes for the ball trick and didn't wash his shoes after the crime. However, Ray corrects his claim and reveals that he started using after the case was settled in the court. In order to lure McCay out, Ray used drugs for real, but ultimately, it was also a way for him to cope with the pain of losing his wife.

evidence.zhHans: 决定性的证据是他开过左轮手枪后鞋上留下的火药。警方一旦在他鞋上查出火药残留，就毫无疑问能证明他是凶手。听到柯南的推理后，Ray 决定去把鞋擦干净，「除掉把自己和案件联系起来的最后一件证据」，却被柯南拦下——柯南用增强威力鞋踢出一记足球打中了他。
evidence.en: The conclusive piece of evidence is the gunpowder on his shoes after firing the revolver. Once the police discover the gunpowder residue on them, it will prove without a doubt that he is the murderer. Hearing Conan's deduction, Ray decides to go clean his shoes to "remove the last piece of evidence connecting him to the crime", but is stopped by Conan who kicks a soccer ball at him via super kick shoes.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Ray Curtis。柯南没有当着众人的面推理，而是让平次单独把他叫到案发现场，因为他想亲自面对 Ray，声称「他最忠实的粉丝」正在等他。Ray 事先在最右下角的房间里用一把拖把和一扇柜门设下了机关。他站在与 McCay 所在房间同层的楼梯顶端踢出一球撞开拖把，从而能在三秒内开灯并射杀 McCay，让他得以在案发时为自己制造不在场证明。
resolution.en: The culprit is Ray Curtis. Instead of performing the deduction in front of everyone, Conan has Heiji call him out to the crime scene alone because he wants to confront Ray by himself, claiming that "his greatest fan" is waiting for him. Ray set up a mechanism at the rightmost bottom room in advance with a mop and a closet's door. By kicking a ball from the top of the stairs on the same floor as the room McCay was in to knock away the mop, Ray was able to turn on the lights and shoot McCay within three seconds. Allowing him to create an alibi for himself at the time of murder.
